subject.title: feat(ui): render MCP Apps in dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw land the stacked durable dashboard MCP App feature, including this Control UI renderer, as the supported product direction?
rationale: This introduces a new persisted MCP App dashboard capability across Gateway authority and Control UI rendering; implementation quality does not by itself establish that the feature scope and lifecycle contract are accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked feature
options.body: Approve the durable MCP App widget direction, land the backend first, and require this UI PR to rebase with exact-head validation.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Request a smaller supported dashboard capability or a clearer ownership boundary before accepting persistent MCP App rendering.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep the implementation unmerged until maintainers want to support persisted MCP App widgets as a product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked feature
recommendation.body: Approve the durable MCP App widget direction, land the backend first, and require this UI PR to rebase with exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both halves of the stacked implementation and are the best available routing contact in the supplied history.
